title: Claude Code telemetry
description: User and session activity, model usage, tool/approval behaviour, waiting time, and hooks/MCP/plugin/retention hygiene for Claude Code, sourced from forwarded OTLP logs in Loki, plus lines of code/active time/commits/pull requests from native OTLP metrics in Mimir (fixed 2026-09-14, lightbridge-governance#335 -- coverage depends on the machine's governance-auth version, see the generator's own docstring). Reshaped 2026-09-14 to match the Codex user/session dashboard's filter and range contract. Generated by scripts/generate_claude_code_dashboard.py -- do not hand-edit; regenerate instead. See docs/integrations/claude-code-dashboard.md.

list.name: user
list.label: User email
list.description: Literal email search; blank includes everyone, including unattributed traffic.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.description: Literal session ID search; blank includes all sessions. Click a session row to select it.

links.title: Export PNG
links.tooltip: Full dashboard image; allow up to 3 minutes. Uses the selected time range and filters.

options.content: Search by email or click a session. Clear searches for everyone. Session times are observed bounds, not lifecycle timestamps; identity coverage is fleet-wide by design. Cost is Claude Code's own reported figure -- a real number, not a governance estimate -- but it is not necessarily the same as an invoice; no admin billing connector is wired here. Tool-decision figures are dominated by a sandbox/permission-mode default, not a human clicking approve; see the source split below. Code acceptance/retention (did a human keep the diff) is not measured -- lines-of-code below counts lines Claude Code wrote, not lines a person reviewed and kept. Lines of code, active time, commits and pull requests come from Mimir, not Loki, and only appear for a machine whose governance-auth has the 2026-09-14 metrics-temporality fix AND has re-run configure -- see this generator's own docstring; a blank panel there is a coverage gap, not zero.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Distinct session IDs with a prompt, priced model call or tool result in the selected period; not session launches.

panels.title: Prompts
panels.description: Observed user_prompt events; may include system-generated follow-ups, not only human-typed messages.

panels.title: Total cost
panels.description: Sum of Claude Code's own reported attributes_cost_usd on api_request lines. A real source-reported figure, not a governance estimate -- see Codex's dashboard for the estimate/actual distinction that does NOT apply here.

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Reported input tokens on api_request lines.

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Reported output tokens on api_request lines.

panels.title: Cache read tokens
panels.description: Reported cache-read tokens on api_request lines. Anthropic reports this as an independent counter, not a confirmed subset of input tokens -- shown as its own total, not a ratio.

panels.title: Request wait · p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of attributes_duration_ms on api_request lines. A different population from human waiting time; a request can be one of several per visible turn.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} |= "api_request" | json | __error__="" | attributes_event_name="api_request" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_duration_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_duration_ms | __error__=""[$__range]) by ()

panels.title: Identity coverage · fleet
panels.description: Share of meaningful events fleet-wide with a nonempty user email. Ignores user/session searches by design. One measured event does not establish complete session coverage.

panels.title: Meaningful activity
panels.description: Events per rolling interval, not events per second. Prompts, priced model calls (api_request) and tool results; hook/MCP/plugin/retention housekeeping and the rare api_error/compaction/subagent_completed diagnostics are excluded from this trend, though each still has its own scoped panel below.

panels.title: Models · responses
panels.description: Share of api_request calls by attributes_model.

panels.title: Models · tokens
panels.description: Share of input plus output tokens by model. Cache read/creation tokens are not added -- see the top-row caveat on why they are shown as independent totals.

targets.expr: sum by (attributes_model)(sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} |= "api_request" | json | __error__="" | attributes_event_name="api_request" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_input_tokens!="" | unwrap attributes_input_tokens | __error__=""[$__range])) + sum by (attributes_model)(sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} |= "api_request" | json | __error__="" | attributes_event_name="api_request" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_output_tokens!="" | unwrap attributes_output_tokens | __error__=""[$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: One row per session. Observed start and last activity are bounded by the selected period, not lifecycle timestamps -- not human active time. Blank cells mean no matching signal, never zero. Click a session to filter this dashboard.

targets.expr: min_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | __error__="" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_event_name=~"user_prompt|api_request|tool_result" | attributes_session_id!="" | label_format observed_ms=`{{ unixEpochMillis (__timestamp__) }}` | unwrap observed_ms | __error__=""[$__range]) by (attributes_session_id)

max_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | __error__="" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_event_name=~"user_prompt|api_request|tool_result" | attributes_session_id!="" | label_format observed_ms=`{{ unixEpochMillis (__timestamp__) }}` | unwrap observed_ms | __error__=""[$__range]) by (attributes_session_id)

sum by (attributes_session_id)(sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} |= "api_request" | json | __error__="" | attributes_event_name="api_request" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id!="" | attributes_cost_usd!="" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd | __error__=""[$__range]))

panels.title: Tool decisions
panels.description: By decision AND source -- source is load-bearing: `config` is a sandbox/permission-mode default, NOT an engineer's decision. See this generator's own docstring for the confirmed 24h/7d fleet figures that motivate the split.

panels.title: Tool success rate
panels.description: By attributes_success on tool_result -- a signal Codex's own telemetry does not carry at all.

panels.title: Code edits · source=config share
panels.description: (count with source=config) / (count total), both restricted to tool_decision on code-editing tools (Edit/Write/NotebookEdit) over the selected range. The closest analogue to Grafana's own 25052 dashboard's code_edit_tool.decision-based accept rate, split by source so a near-100% figure reads as "policy default", not "engineers love what the agent writes".

panels.title: Invocation source
panels.description: By attributes_query_source on assistant_response -- independent of app.entrypoint. Confirmed live values include sdk, prompt_suggestion, agent:builtin:general-purpose, web_fetch_apply, web_search_tool, compact. A high `sdk` share means most matching traffic is Agent-SDK-driven, not a human typing at an interactive prompt.

panels.title: Request waiting time
panels.description: Median/p95 attributes_duration_ms on api_request. A different population from human waiting time or turn-level latency; never sum percentiles.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} |= "api_request" | json | __error__="" | attributes_event_name="api_request" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_duration_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_duration_ms | __error__=""[$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} |= "api_request" | json | __error__="" | attributes_event_name="api_request" | attributes_user_email=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | attributes_session_id=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | attributes_duration_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_duration_ms | __error__=""[$__interval]) by ()

panels.title: API errors
panels.description: count_over_time on api_error.

panels.title: Error details
panels.description: A native Loki "Logs" panel -- the raw api_error/tool_result(success=false) lines themselves, not an aggregate. Prompt content is never captured here (redacted at the source).

panels.title: Top hooks
panels.description: topk(10, ...) by attributes_hook_name over the selected range.

panels.title: MCP connections · transport
panels.description: By attributes_transport_type on mcp_server_connection. Confirmed live values: stdio, http.

panels.title: Lines added
panels.description: sum(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added", user/session filter}[$__range])). Lines Claude Code wrote via Edit/Write/NotebookEdit -- not lines a human reviewed and kept. Only a machine running a governance-auth build with the 2026-09-14 metrics-temporality fix, that has re-run configure, emits this -- NO DATA means an un-updated machine, not zero activity.

panels.title: Lines removed
panels.description: Same query, type="removed". Only a machine running a governance-auth build with the 2026-09-14 metrics-temporality fix, that has re-run configure, emits this -- NO DATA means an un-updated machine, not zero activity.

panels.title: Active time
panels.description: sum(increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{...}[$__range])), both type=user (keyboard) and type=cli (tool execution/AI responses) combined -- see the breakdown trend to the right for the split. Only a machine running a governance-auth build with the 2026-09-14 metrics-temporality fix, that has re-run configure, emits this -- NO DATA means an un-updated machine, not zero activity.

panels.title: Commits
panels.description: sum(increase(claude_code_commit_count_total{...}[$__range])) -- commits made through Claude Code specifically, not every commit in a touched repository. Only a machine running a governance-auth build with the 2026-09-14 metrics-temporality fix, that has re-run configure, emits this -- NO DATA means an un-updated machine, not zero activity.

panels.title: Pull requests
panels.description: sum(increase(claude_code_pull_request_count_total{...}[$__range])) -- created via shell command or an MCP tool. Only a machine running a governance-auth build with the 2026-09-14 metrics-temporality fix, that has re-run configure, emits this -- NO DATA means an un-updated machine, not zero activity.

panels.title: Lines of code over time
panels.description: Added vs removed, per $__interval -- the trend 25052 has that this dashboard could not show before the 2026-09-14 temporality fix. Only a machine running a governance-auth build with the 2026-09-14 metrics-temporality fix, that has re-run configure, emits this -- NO DATA means an un-updated machine, not zero activity.
